title: dt/2 check of 20261026T1302-c42-foodchain-both-divide-claim: with the world's own step halved (dt 0.5 -> 0.25), both species still divide (prey generation 2 and 8, predators 3 and 3) and coexist to t=12000 on seeds 0 and 1
summary: The claim's world.py run with WORLD_P {"dt":0.25} (the world's integration step; labkit --spf 400 --dt 0.25 keeps 100 t per frame), 128^2, seeds 0 and 1, t=12000, --lineage-k 5. Prey: persistent splits 3 and 20 (max generation 2 and 8; at dt 0.5: 9 and 17, generation 2 and 6), merge/split 0.25 and 0.11. Predators: persistent splits 36 and 30 (generation 3 and 3; at dt 0.5: 30 and 34, generation 2 and 2), merge/split 0.33 and 0.31. Components at the end: prey 6 and 10, predators 24 and 23. The coexistence and the reproduction of both kinds do not depend on the time step; seed 0's prey splits are fewer (3 vs 9).

finding.operator: time-step halving of the claim world
finding.result: prey persistent splits 3/20 (gen 2/8) vs 9/17 (gen 2/6); predator 36/30 (gen 3/3) vs 30/34 (gen 2/2); predators alive at the end on both
